glosses: Popular supposed name for a caveman or other prehistoric man.
A feeling of fear, horror or disgust.

examples.text: He took an ug at's meht.
What an ug ye've myed yorsel.

glosses: The pectoral fin of a fish.

examples.text: Wha weds a cankert thriftless wife, / Weds to his days eternal strife, / For, like the Tron-Kirk bell, / She ever hammers on his lugs, / Till her an' hame at last he uggs / As the dire door o' hell!

glosses: To fear, be horrified; shudder with horror.
